headlines.description: — Sabres coach Lindy Ruff shut down any talk of putting forwards Tyson Kozak and Jason Zucker back in after injuries sent them to the locker room late in Game 4 of Buffalo's first-round playoff series against the Bruins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabres erupt for 4 goals in first period, win 6-1 to push Bruins to 3-1 hole in series

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon had two goals and an assist, Nicolas Roy and Devon Toews scored in the third period, and the top-seeded Colorado Avalanche swept the Los Angeles Kings out of the first round of the Stanley Cup playoffs with a 5-1 victory in Game 4...
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon leads Avalanche to 5-1 win and 1st-round sweep of LA Kings, ending Anze Kopitar's career

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel scored his NHL playoffs-leading fifth and sixth goals in the third period and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied to beat the Montreal Canadiens 3-2 on Sunday night in Game 4 to tie the series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hagel scores twice in 3rd, Lightning beat Canadiens 3-2 in Game 4 to tie series

headlines.description: — Ryan Poehling scored 2:29 into overtime, and the Anaheim Ducks pushed Connor McDavid and the Edmonton Oilers to the brink of first-round elimination with a 4-3 victory in Game 4 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Poehling scores early in OT, Ducks push Oilers to the brink with 4-3 win in Game 4
